Callout.Name: Shots at a Farmhouse
Callout.Advisory: Family inside and safe, no injuries.

Script.Line: It came through the kitchen window and I was stood right there.
Two shots. From the field behind the house.
I have got the round. I picked it up off the floor with a cloth.

Lines.Approach: They put a shot through a window with the family inside. That is not poaching.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
